exposure: Presence of adnexal mass in the third trimester of pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent cesarean section and cystectomy for adnexal masses in the third trimester of pregnancy over a 10-year period
finding: Dermoid cysts were the most common type of adnexal mass (46%) found in a cohort of women who delivered via cesarean section due to adnexal masses in the third trimester, and fetal outcomes were generally positive.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the preferred mode of delivery for women with large adnexal masses in the third trimester.
